commit.message:
[Hunter] MM Patch 12.1.5 APL

1. Less Trueshot holding in DRoute.
2. Improved Liquid Luster handling somewhat (but needs some Font usage work to be played like we do ingame).
3. Clean-up of conditions that would never come up.
4. Ungated Multi-Shot focus dump on AoE for small gains.
5. Remove some "max prio" gates since it's on by default and I have yet to encounter a single usecase for someone turning it off since almost all AoE APL work happens on DRoute anyway where prio is prized into the result.
6. Remove Mark-chasing from PS spenders for significant prio gains.
7. Removed all Unload-specific APL gimmicks and clipping.
8. Allow Aimed>RF during Trueshot.
9. Simplify/merge Rapid Fire lines.
